title: 第2章 老福尔摩斯
content_zh:
第2章 老福尔摩斯
尸体没回答江远，但这并不妨碍江远的判断。
十七叔是父亲的远房堂弟，平时见面的机会并不多，但逢年过节，总能遇上，加上他出众的体型，江远自问没有认错。
一时间，江远的情绪有些波动。
紧接着，江远又不由的想起父亲劝说自己回老家考公时说的话：“老家到处都有亲戚熟人，做什么事都方便，回老家比在大城市舒服多了。”
果然，父亲没有说错，哪怕自己做的是法医，也能遇到亲戚熟人的尸体。
相隔不久，老法医吴军抵达了现场。
他穿了件白大褂，肚子微隆，像是名坐办公室的老干部似的，眯着眼看了看四周，再仰头瞅了眼江远，笑笑道：“小江先到了，去把勘查箱拿过来吧？”
“带来了。”江远积极的不行，早就从勘察车里，将一只大黑箱子提溜了过来，厚厚重重的很有质感的样子。
等物，下盖却是胡乱的分成三个区域，乱糟糟的有棉花有纱布，有注射器有卷尺，有不锈钢餐盒，有毛巾……
“多取几个口罩，给大家都发上。人手一只。”吴军自己拿了一个戴好，看着江远给现场的民警都发了口罩，才考校式的问：“知道为啥第一件事，是给大家发口罩？”
江远道：“起防护作用，也避免污染现场。”
“这是书本上的理由。”吴军给已经戴了两层手套的右手，又戴上第三只手套，且道：“让你给每个人发口罩的另一个原因，是为了遮盖表情。”
江远一愣。
吴军继续道：“做警察的，做法医的，都是见多了尸体的。有的人，尤其是你们年轻人，说话说着说着，表情就控制不住了，万一有人笑出来，再遇到媒体或者群众拍照，这就很麻烦了。所以，我的勘探箱子里，带最多的永远是口罩。来现场的有一个算一个，都戴上了再说话。”
江远恍然。
吴军这时候才俯身做起了现场勘察。
江远也学着多套了两层手套，再道：“师父，这个人……尸体，我认识。”
“哦？怎么说。”正在观察尸体位置的吴军看向了江远。
“看着像我十七叔。”江远呼了一口气。

吴军沉默两秒，问：“有把握吗？”
“双下巴，大肚子，大鼻子，旁边有大痣……应该是十七叔了。”江远略保守的形容了一下。
“节哀顺变。说说你十七叔的情况吧。”吴军再次低头，道：“温度计。”
江远的目光移开，从勘察箱里取了温度计给吴军，再开口道：“我十七叔今年应该是50岁，是我二爷爷的小儿子。属猪。他家很早搬到县一中家属院了，在跟前开了一家小餐馆，有车。爱抽烟，有一些债务纠纷……”
吴军一边听一边做检查，并让江远做记录，接着又要了穿刺针和注射器，抽了血尿备用。
不一会儿，刑警大队长也赶了过来，紧接着，就是县局主管刑侦的副局长和局长，亦是匆匆而来。
“法医这边有什么结论？”局长亲自询问，身后跟着副局长，刑警大队的大队长黄强民，以及包括刘队长在内的几名刑警大队的中队长。
命案是刑事案件中最受重视的，尤其是新发生的命案，配置以行政级别来计算，得是普通案件的上百倍。
最近些年，命案的发生率明显呈下降趋势，但对警方来说，重视程度则是直线上升。
吴军不慌不忙的站起身，挺了挺肚子，道：“致死原因，初步估计，是锐器插入后颈造成的颅脑损伤，目前没有发现其他的伤口。具体情况要回去剖开了看一下。”
局长“恩”了一声，自己也观察着现场。
吴军继续道：“尸体有搬运的痕迹，地面上的血迹也很少，所以，死者应该是被抛尸在了这边……”
“很有可能是激情杀人后抛尸了。”大队长黄强民等吴军说的差不多了，给出了一句判断。
局长缓缓点头，看看两边正在拍照和提取血迹和痕迹的民警，问：“关于被害人，现在有什么情报？”
“死者今年50岁，属猪。”吴军语气依旧的报告。
局长等人的目光不由再次集中在了法医身上。
吴军平静的看看众人，道：“死者家住县一中家属院，开了一家小餐馆，有车，爱抽烟，有一些债务纠纷。”
正在弯腰看伤口的刘队长，不由自主的直起身来，讶然的看向吴军：“老吴，可以啊，这都能推理出来，老福尔摩斯啊。不过，开饭店和爱抽烟，是因为手指上有油烟和烟渍？债务纠纷怎么看出来的？”
吴军笑而不语，很享受的样子。
(本章完)

Chapter 2 Old Sherlock Holmes
The corpse did not answer Jiang Yuan, but this did not hinder Jiang Yuan's judgment.
Uncle Seventeen was his father's distant cousin. He didn't have many opportunities to meet him on weekdays, but he could always meet him during the holidays. Coupled with his outstanding figure, Jiang Yuan asked himself whether he had admitted his mistake.
For a moment, Jiang Yuan's mood fluctuated a little.
Immediately afterwards, Jiang Yuan couldn't help but think of what his father said when he persuaded him to return to his hometown to take the public examination: "There are relatives and acquaintances everywhere in my hometown, and everything is convenient. Going back to my hometown is much more comfortable than in a big city."
Sure enough, my father was right. Even if he was a forensic doctor, he would still encounter the corpses of relatives and acquaintances.
Not long after, veteran forensic doctor Wu Jun arrived at the scene.
He was wearing a white coat and had a slightly swollen belly. He looked like a veteran cadre sitting in the office. He squinted and looked around, then raised his head and glanced at Jiang Yuan. He smiled and said, "Xiao Jiang is here first, go get the survey box?"
"Bring it here." Jiang Yuan was very active. He had already slipped a big black box out of the survey car. It was thick and heavy with texture.
etc., but the lower cover is randomly divided into three areas. There are cotton and gauze in a mess, syringes, tape measures, stainless steel lunch boxes, towels...
"Get a few more masks and distribute them to everyone. Each person has one hand." Wu Jun took one and put it on himself. After watching Jiang Yuan distribute masks to the policemen at the scene, he asked in a school-like manner: "You know why the first thing is to distribute masks to everyone?"
Jiang Yuandao: "It plays a protective role and also avoids contamination of the site."
"This is the reason in the book." Wu Jun put on a third glove on his right hand that had already worn two layers of gloves, and said: "Another reason why you should give everyone a mask is to cover their expressions."
Jiang Yuan was stunned.
Wu Jun continued: "Police officers and forensic doctors have seen too many corpses. Some people, especially you young people, can't control their expressions while talking. If someone laughs, it will be very troublesome if the media or the crowd take pictures. Therefore, the most important thing in my exploration box is always a mask. Everyone who comes to the scene wears them before talking."
Jiang Yuan suddenly realized.
At this time, Wu Jun leaned over and began to conduct on-site inspections.
Jiang Yuan also learned to put on two more layers of gloves, and then said: "Master, I know this person...the corpse."
"Oh? What do you say?" Wu Jun, who was observing the position of the corpse, looked at Jiang Yuan.
"Looks like my seventeenth uncle." Jiang Yuan breathed out.
Wu Jun was silent for two seconds and asked: "Are you sure?"
"Double chin, big belly, big nose, and a big mole on the side... he must be Uncle Seventeen." Jiang Yuan described it conservatively.
"My condolences. Please tell me about your seventeenth uncle." Wu Jun lowered his head again and said, "Thermometer."
Jiang Yuan looked away, took a thermometer from the survey box and gave it to Wu Jun, and then said: "My seventeenth uncle should be 50 years old this year, and he is the youngest son of my second grandfather. He is a pig. His family moved to the family courtyard of the County No. 1 Middle School very early, opened a small restaurant nearby, and has a car. He loves to smoke and has some debt disputes..."
Wu Jun was doing the examination while listening, and asked Jiang Yuan to take notes. Then he asked for a puncture needle and syringe, and drew blood and urine for later use.
After a while, the criminal police captain also rushed over, and soon after, the deputy director and director of the county bureau in charge of criminal investigation also came in a hurry.
"What conclusion does the forensic doctor have?" the director asked personally, followed by the deputy director, Huang Qiangmin, the captain of the criminal police brigade, and several squadron captains of the criminal police brigade, including Captain Liu.
Homicide cases are the most important among criminal cases, especially new murder cases. The allocation based on administrative level is hundreds of times that of ordinary cases.
In recent years, the incidence of homicides has been clearly on a downward trend, but for the police, the level of attention it pays has skyrocketed.
Wu Jun stood up calmlyHe stood up, held out his belly, and said: "The cause of death is initially estimated to be craniocerebral injury caused by a sharp instrument being inserted into the back of the neck. No other wounds have been found so far. We need to go back and do an incision to check the specific situation."
The director said "yes" and observed the scene himself.
Wu Jun continued: "There are traces of moving the body, and there are very few blood stains on the ground. Therefore, the deceased should have been dumped here..."
"It's very possible that he killed someone in passion and then dumped the body." Captain Huang Qiangmin waited until Wu Jun had finished speaking and then made a judgment.
The director nodded slowly, looked at the policemen on both sides who were taking pictures and extracting blood stains and traces, and asked, "What information do you have about the victim now?"
"The deceased was 50 years old and was born in the year of Pig." Wu Jun reported in the same tone.
The director and others couldn't help but focus on the forensic doctor again.
Wu Jun looked at everyone calmly and said: "The deceased lived in the family home of No. 1 Middle School in the county. He opened a small restaurant, had a car, loved to smoke, and had some debt disputes."
Captain Liu, who was bending down to look at the wound, involuntarily straightened up and looked at Wu Jun in surprise: "Old Wu, yes, we can all deduce this, old Holmes. But, opening a restaurant and loving to smoke are because of oil smoke and cigarette stains on your fingers? How can you tell about the debt dispute?"
Wu Jun smiled and said nothing, looking like he was enjoying himself.
(End of chapter)
